tasks.subject: Task 1: Live section timestamps reach pickCandidates
tasks.description:
**Goal:** The incremental sync filters sections on the timestamp this run's tree read observed, not on a copy frozen in Firestore since the last structure rewrite.

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/mirror-sync.ts` — reconcileStructure (:534-577), incrementalPass (:490-524), sweepPass (:999-1037); add withLiveMtimes
- Modify: `test/mirror-sync.test.ts` — fakeStore.putStructure (:229-232), harness (:303)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- reconcileStructure returns live section timestamps whether or not it rewrote the structure
- incrementalPass and sweepPass both overlay them before pickCandidates
- The test fake's putStructure replaces data.sections and data.groups the way Firestore's does
- A regression test drives three runs with a stable structure and asserts an edit on the third is listed and fetched
- The eight named tests pass again

**Verify:** `npm run typecheck && npm test`

**Steps:** failing regression test; faithful putStructure fake; run and see the eight breakages; add treeFrom and rebuild harness; reconcileStructure returns StructureResult; add withLiveMtimes and use it in both passes; run; correct structureHashOf's docstring; commit.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/mirror-sync.ts", "test/mirror-sync.test.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npm run typecheck && npm test", "acceptanceCriteria": ["reconcileStructure returns live timestamps regardless of the hash", "both passes overlay them before pickCandidates", "the store fake replaces collections like Firestore", "a three-run regression test proves an edit is still noticed"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: A structure write touches only what the tree changed
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Rewriting the structure stops resetting sync-owned state and stops writing documents whose tree fields did not move. A notebook nobody edited comes out with its watermark, page count and childGroupsKnown intact and no Firestore write against it.

**Why:** structureHashOf covers every notebook and section in the account; any hash change called putStructure, which set every document with no merge using buildStructure's output — including pagesSyncedThrough: null. So renaming one section, or creating a notebook in an unmirrored corner, reset every watermark and triggered a full re-backfill.

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/mirror-schema.ts` — identity helpers, tree-field types, creation defaults
- Modify: `src/mirror-sync.ts` — buildStructure emits tree fields plus identity; structureHashOf hashes the identity lines
- Modify: `src/mirror-store.ts:563-604` — #replaceCollection merges and skips unchanged documents
- Modify: `README.md` — the one-off first-deploy rewrite
- Test: `test/mirror-schema.test.ts`, `test/mirror-sync.test.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Renaming one section writes exactly one section document and no other
- No structure write clears pagesSyncedThrough, pageCount, lastSweptAt, childGroupsKnown, pendingWrites or pendingWritesSince on an existing document
- A newly appearing section is created with pagesSyncedThrough: null and a new group with childGroupsKnown: false
- Adding a notebook to notebookIds writes only that notebook's own documents
- A section that disappears from the tree is still deleted
- structureHashOf and the per-document skip agree, because both read the same identity string

**Verify:** `npm run typecheck && npm test`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/mirror-schema.ts", "src/mirror-sync.ts", "src/mirror-store.ts", "README.md", "test/mirror-schema.test.ts", "test/mirror-sync.test.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npm run typecheck && npm test", "acceptanceCriteria": ["a rename writes one document", "no structure write resets sync-owned fields", "defaults apply only on creation", "deletion by absence still works", "hash and per-document skip share one identity"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Widening is per notebook, not global
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Adding a notebook to notebookIds or activeNotebookIds makes only that notebook's sections eligible for a wide scan. No other notebook is listed, fetched or re-checked because of it.

**Why:** reconcileActivity nulled sectionsScannedThrough, which is global — one activation cost a listing request for every section in the account. Only candidacy needs widening: each section still lists against its own untouched pagesSyncedThrough.

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/mirror-schema.ts` — selectionSeen, mirroredNotebookIdsSeen, activeNotebookIdsSeen, wideScanNotebookIds, notebooksNeedingWideScan; remove activeSelectionHash
- Modify: `src/mirror-sync.ts` — reconcileActivity becomes reconcileSelection; pickCandidates takes a wide-scan set; incrementalPass clears it; remove activeSelectionHashOf
- Modify: `CLAUDE.md` — replace the "Changing the active set clears sectionsScannedThrough" paragraph
- Test: `test/mirror-schema.test.ts`, `test/mirror-sync.test.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Adding one notebook to activeNotebookIds lists only that notebook's sections
- Adding one notebook to notebookIds lists only that notebook's sections
- Removing a notebook from either list widens nothing
- sectionsScannedThrough is never nulled by a selection change
- A run that did not complete keeps the wide-scan set
- The first run after deploy records the lists and widens nothing
- activeNotebookIds going from a list to null widens every mirrored notebook that was not already active, and nothing else

**Verify:** `npm run typecheck && npm test`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/mirror-schema.ts", "src/mirror-sync.ts", "CLAUDE.md", "test/mirror-schema.test.ts", "test/mirror-sync.test.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npm run typecheck && npm test", "acceptanceCriteria": ["per-notebook widening only", "removal widens nothing", "sectionsScannedThrough never nulled by a selection change", "the set survives a budget-stopped run", "first run after deploy widens nothing"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: The sweep carries titles and notices content drift
tasks.description:
**Goal:** The nightly sweep stores real page titles instead of '', and marks a page stale when Graph's timestamp has moved past the mirror's — at no extra Graph request.

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/graph-structure.ts:559-565` — listPageIds becomes listPageSummaries
- Modify: `src/mirror-schema.ts` — PageStamp, MirrorPageDigest, pageHasDrifted
- Modify: `src/mirror-store.ts:367-373` — listPageIdsInSection becomes listPageDigestsInSection
- Modify: `src/mirror-sync.ts` — SyncGraph, SyncStore, sweepSection (:1073-1113)
- Test: `test/mirror-schema.test.ts`, `test/mirror-sync.test.ts`, `test/graph-structure.test.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- listPageSummaries requests $select=id,title,lastModifiedDateTime
- A discovered page is stored with its real title and Graph's timestamp
- A page in both places whose timestamps differ is marked stale and costs no Graph request
- A non-present stored copy is not marked again
- A failed enumeration deletes nothing and marks nothing

**Verify:** `npm run typecheck && npm test`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/graph-structure.ts", "src/mirror-schema.ts", "src/mirror-store.ts", "src/mirror-sync.ts", "test/mirror-schema.test.ts", "test/mirror-sync.test.ts", "test/graph-structure.test.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npm run typecheck && npm test", "acceptanceCriteria": ["wider $select on the sweep listing", "discovered pages carry a real title and stamp", "drift marks stale at no Graph cost", "a failed enumeration changes nothing"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: A short-circuited write corrects a locally stamped timestamp
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A page whose lastModifiedDateTime holds resyncPage's local clock value gets Graph's own string back the next time the sync reads it, so Task 7's equality test can ever match.

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/mirror-store.ts:426-436` — putPageMetadata also stamps contentSyncedAt
- Modify: `src/mirror-sync.ts` — PageWriteDeps, SyncStore, writePageFromRaw short-circuit (:884-895)
- Test: `test/mirror-sync.test.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- A short-circuit whose live stamp differs writes metadata and returns false
- A short-circuit whose stamps match writes nothing
- A live stamp of '' never overwrites a stored one
- putPageMetadata refreshes contentSyncedAt

**Verify:** `npm run typecheck && npm test`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/mirror-store.ts", "src/mirror-sync.ts", "test/mirror-sync.test.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npm run typecheck && npm test", "acceptanceCriteria": ["a differing stamp is patched on the short-circuit", "matching stamps write nothing", "an empty live stamp never overwrites", "putPageMetadata stamps contentSyncedAt"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 6: Measure the clock skew and what the overlap actually catches
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Two log events that turn TIMESTAMP_SETTLE_MS and the overlap width from chosen numbers into measured ones. Must land before Task 8, because an overlap-save event is only informative while the window is still wide.

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/graph-throttle.ts` — recordClockSkew, CLOCK_SKEW_LOG_THRESHOLD_MS
- Modify: `src/graph-structure.ts` (graphGet), `src/page-content.ts:126`, `src/page-write.ts:261` — call it
- Modify: `src/mirror-sync.ts` — syncPage returns whether it wrote; syncSection logs sync-overlap-save
- Test: `test/graph-throttle.test.ts`, `test/mirror-sync.test.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- recordClockSkew returns signed skew ms and logs only past the threshold
- A missing or unparseable Date header returns null and logs nothing
- sync-overlap-save fires only for a page that was written and whose stamp predates the section watermark
- Neither event carries a title, a section name, or a URL

**Verify:** `npm run typecheck && npm test`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/graph-throttle.ts", "src/graph-structure.ts", "src/page-content.ts", "src/page-write.ts", "src/mirror-sync.ts", "test/graph-throttle.test.ts", "test/mirror-sync.test.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npm run typecheck && npm test", "acceptanceCriteria": ["skew read from the Date header at all three fetch sites", "threshold-gated logging", "overlap-save fires only on a written page below the watermark", "no user content in either event"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 7: Skip the content fetch for a page whose stamp has not moved
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A page listed only because it fell inside the overlap window costs no Graph request.

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/mirror-schema.ts` — TIMESTAMP_SETTLE_MS, storedPageIsCurrent
- Modify: `src/mirror-sync.ts` — syncSection pre-check, syncPage and writePageFromRaw accept the already-read document, pagesSkipped in the report
- Test: `test/mirror-schema.test.ts`, `test/mirror-sync.test.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- An unchanged page inside the overlap window costs no fetchRaw and no Firestore write
- A changed stamp, a changed title, a moved section, a non-present state and an unsettled copy each force the fetch
- The skip reads the page document once, not twice
- pagesSkipped appears in the report and the sync-completed line

**Verify:** `npm run typecheck && npm test`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/mirror-schema.ts", "src/mirror-sync.ts", "test/mirror-schema.test.ts", "test/mirror-sync.test.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npm run typecheck && npm test", "acceptanceCriteria": ["unchanged pages cost no Graph request", "five separate clauses each force a fetch", "one Firestore read per page, not two", "pagesSkipped reported"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 8: The section-scan overlap drops to fifteen minutes
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A section edited once stops being re-listed on every run for an hour afterwards.

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/mirror-schema.ts` — SECTION_SCAN_OVERLAP_MS
- Modify: `src/mirror-sync.ts:687` — pickCandidates passes it
- Modify: `README.md` — the request-budget table
- Test: `test/mirror-sync.test.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- pickCandidates uses a 15-minute cutoff and the page listing still uses an hour
- A section 20 minutes older than the scan watermark is not a candidate
- A section 10 minutes older still is
- A never-synced section is a candidate whatever its stamp
- A section in a wide-scan notebook is a candidate whatever its stamp

**Verify:** `npm run typecheck && npm test`
